resources.string: Vula izici ezengeziwe futhi ube ngumnikazi ukuze usekele ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo!
I-Bluetooth Volume Manager ayinazo izikhangiso futhi ayithengisi idatha yabasebenzisi. Ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwenziwa kuphela nguwe.
Yiba ngumnikazi futhi uxhase ukuthuthukiswa! Thepha inkinobho engezansi ukuze unike amandla zonke izici ezengeziwe futhi uvule iphrofayili yami ye-GitHub Sponsors.

• Imizila engenali
• Izenzo zokuxhuma zezithubutuhu
• Ukwenyusa imibono
• Ukulawula umthwali ophumelele
• Okusekela ukuthuthuka kwe-open-source 🧙
Enye indlela izikhangiso, ukuhlaziya ne-Google Play 🙁
Ubuyile kakade? Ukusekela kwakho kugcina i-BVM iphila!
Yiba ongolutho ukuvula izici ezengeziwe futhi ukhuthaze nokuqhubeka nokuthuthuka.
Uvule lonke izici ezongeza ngokusekela umthuthukiso we-open-source.
